entry.title: Former Estée Lauder exec no longer with Gap Inc.
entry.summary: John Demsey began advising for the retailer about a year ago as the company sought to revamp its beauty business.

entry.title: Walmart opens next-gen California facility to boost West Coast fulfillment
entry.summary: The 900,000-square-foot site is equipped with an automated storage and retrieval system to help increase order capacity to enable faster shipping.

entry.title: Dick’s Sporting Goods’ seasonal hiring slips
entry.summary: The athletics retailer is echoing a national pattern of retailers pulling back on hiring workers for the holidays.

entry.title: Mattel names second CFO in under 18 months
entry.summary: Peter Griffith joins from a biotech company. Paul Ruh, who has been CFO since the spring of 2025, will serve as an adviser through the end of the year.

entry.title: Shoppers expect less for more this holiday season. That could mean a sales decline.
entry.summary: Some of the latest projections suggest spending could drop, but even those that predict growth recognize consumers are pressured.

entry.title: Anthropologie’s holiday marketing seeks to balance emotion, business impact
entry.summary: Sentimental ads and a creator-led social series are complemented by offerings like a new DoorDash partnership, CMO Barbra Sainsurin said.

entry.title: UPS’ Happy Returns comes to TikTok Shop
entry.summary: Pacsun and Everlane are among the retailers tapping into the new integration ahead of the post-holiday returns rush.

entry.title: Can Best Buy be the new gaming boss?
entry.summary: The electronics retailer is piloting a gaming hub that brings together content, deals and preorders, and will also open a dedicated gaming hub inside a store in California.

entry.title: Magic: The Gathering reaches record $600M in quarterly revenue
entry.summary: Parent company Hasbro raised its 2026 financial outlook as it reported its strongest quarter of the year.

entry.title: Walmart enlists Sam’s Club in latest challenge to Amazon Prime
entry.summary: The retail giant has bundled its Walmart+ and Sam’s Club Plus memberships for a savings of nearly $100, which could appeal to stressed-out consumers.
